title: Offline Crush Route Builder
oneLiner: A playful city-social route planner for dating-app-burned singles who need recurring real-world contexts, not another swipe deck.
theme: 외로움 / 성욕 / 역전 - app fatigue, offline confidence, social proof, and low-pressure romantic opportunity.
stitchPrompt: Build a playful experimental web app prototype called "Offline Crush Route Builder" for dating-app-burned singles who want recurring real-world contexts instead of more swiping. The first screen must be a working social route builder with a loneliness-to-momentum header, interest and comfort intake, recurring-context map, friend-to-date ladder, four-week route calendar, reflection cards, and shareable wingmate plan. Use realistic sample data: a new-city 27-year-old, trivia night, soccer meetup, DnD table, volunteering shift, coffee walk, $40 weekly budget, social anxiety, one friend invite, and a low-pressure follow-up script. Design direction: use the playful-experimental profile with a memorable city-night route composition, bold but readable accents, charming social cards, and one obvious main workflow from app fatigue to next offline plan. Do not make a marketing landing page; the first screen must be the working app.
